empty_feed_modal.body:
This usually means browser authentication is not working.
Make sure you are signed in to YouTube in your browser.

image_warning_modal.title: ⚠  Image protocol not supported
image_warning_modal.body:
Your terminal or tmux configuration does not support the Kitty or Sixel graphics protocols.
Thumbnails will be drawn as ANSI block art instead.

For native images, use [bold]Kitty[/bold], [bold]WezTerm[/bold] or [bold]iTerm2[/bold], and run TermTube outside tmux.

help_screen.title: TermTube — Keyboard Reference
help_screen.move_page: Previous / next page of the list.
help_screen.move_ends: First / last item of the whole list.
help_screen.move_menu: Open the action menu for the row.
help_screen.move_back: Go back (in Library, from the list to the rail; in Search, to the previous results).
help_screen.move_jump: Jump to a tab / open the tab picker.
help_screen.play_watch: Watch the video / choose the quality first.
help_screen.play_audio: Play the audio / choose the quality first (replaces the current track).
help_screen.play_enqueue: Add the audio to the queue.
help_screen.play_skip: Skip to the next queued track.
help_screen.play_queue: Open the queue: j/k move, J/K reorder, D remove, u undo, Enter play now.
help_screen.play_stop: Stop the audio and clear the queue.
help_screen.row_download: Download (video or audio, with a quality picker).
help_screen.tools_filter: Filter the loaded list as you type (Enter keeps the filter, Esc clears it).
help_screen.tools_mark: Mark the row and move down / mark the whole page.
help_screen.tools_remove: Remove the row or the marked rows from this list, after one y / N confirmation (History, Library, playlists).
help_screen.rail_rail: Move focus between the side list of sources and the rows. Backspace also goes to the side list.
help_screen.rail_rail_nav: In the side list: move, then Enter shows that source (on + New playlist it creates one). h on the first page also goes there; l goes back.
help_screen.library_filter: Filter with words and tokens: type:audio dur:<10m by:"name" year:2024 pl:name dl:yes
help_screen.library_playlist_new: New playlist / rename the highlighted or open playlist.
help_screen.library_delete: On the rail: delete the playlist (its videos stay on disk). In a playlist: remove the videos from it.
help_screen.library_reorder: Inside a playlist: move the video down / up.
help_screen.library_playlist_play: Play / shuffle / queue the open or highlighted playlist as audio.
help_screen.library_playlist_dialog: In the playlist dialog: Space selects several playlists, Enter toggles them.
help_screen.history_import: On a YouTube source: copy the rows (or the marked ones) into local history. Rows already there are kept.
help_screen.app_search: Search (↑↓ earlier searches, Ctrl+D forgets one).
help_screen.app_sort: Search tab: sort / type. On local History, s cycles recent, most watched and longest watched.
help_screen.app_refresh: Refresh the current feed (clears its cache).
help_screen.app_hide_played: Home tab: show or hide videos you have already played (the footer counts the hidden ones).
help_screen.app_quit: Quit (the audio queue is not saved).
help_screen.channel_description: Fold the channel description to three lines / show it all again.
help_screen.channel_playlist: On a playlist row: open its videos (Esc returns to the list).
help_screen.channel_follow: Follow or unfollow this channel locally (kept in channels.json, no account needed).
help_screen.channel_owner: Playlist page: open the channel that owns the playlist.
help_screen.channel_playlist_bulk: Open playlist: play all / add all to the queue / save as a local playlist.
help_screen.channel_global: Search, settings, help, quit (as on the main page).
help_screen.config_browser: auto / none / firefox / chrome / … (cookie source for your account feeds)

deps.cookies_body:
TermTube reads cookies directly from your browser.
  Set the browser in your config file or in Settings > Browser:

    Config: {config}

    browser: auto       # detect automatically (default)
    browser: firefox    # use Firefox
    browser: chrome     # use Chrome (may ask for keychain access)
    browser: none       # no authentication

  You must be signed in to YouTube in that browser.
  On macOS, Firefox is recommended (it needs no keychain prompt).
